edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest a small average effect that is directionally consistent but not dramatic.
edges.mechanism: This factor likely influences Cardiovascular disease through a mix of reserve, disability, social engagement, inflammation, and shared chronic-disease burden rather than one single biochemical pathway. That matters because some of these variables behave partly as markers of physiologic aging and partly as modifiable contributors.
edges.summary: In general adult, pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest that periodontal disease tracks with higher risk of cardiovascular disease. Most disagreement in the literature is about size, subgroup sensitivity, or dose threshold rather than about whether the relationship exists at all.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
